decision: The registered identity/resource preflight passed, but it does not establish production throughput. Starting production would be predictably censored far below the 384-record-per-cell minimum. Production arming is therefore withdrawn pending a semantics-preserving throughput remediation.

remediation_acceptance.semantic_replay: The optimized implementation must reproduce all 12 frozen preflight posteriors to maximum sector error at most 1e-10.
remediation_acceptance.throughput: The same frozen timing matrix must project the entire registered minimum production and sensitivity matrix to at most 7200 wall seconds with four workers.
remediation_acceptance.scope: No production histories, reduced record counts, removed sensitivity branches, relaxed gates, new chi values or external dependencies.
